description: Angular component class for configuring an alarms table widget, including form setup, validation, and configuration output handling.

classes.name: AlarmsTableBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring alarms table widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form inputs.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Retrieves data keys from the alarm source.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets data keys for the alarm source.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets widget config flags based on selected card buttons.
